description: List the external plugins a plugin was imported from: the URL and revision or the uploaded zip, the external plugin's name, licence class and the items it owns in the plugin. The installed plugin without `plugin`. Returns an array ({items} in structuredContent).

plugin.description: Name of the plugin, or its id with pluginById (CLI: --plugin).

pluginById.description: `plugin` is a plugin id, not a name (CLI: --plugin-by-id).

name: plugins_external_sources
title: List external plugin sources
